effect.name: Cosmic Burn
effect.desc: Burn-dissolve effect that traces a glowing fire ring along the layer's alpha edge (from a blurred-alpha isoline) with noise-roughened edges, heat ripple distortion, hotspot shaping, outer aura and optional alpha cutout behind the ring. Supports fire or rainbow palettes, tinting, auto-animated burn progression and Normal/Multiply/Screen blending.
